projects.title: Small-Image Classification Capstone
bullets: Loaded public small-image datasets from natural-scene collections as part of a supervised undergraduate capstone project.
Trained a compact image classifier using Python and PyTorch for the capstone topic of classification under input changes.

research.title: Reproducible Scientific Table Processing
bullets: Reproduced summary tables from raw inputs in public bibliographic analysis workflows as a supervised student research assistant.
Assembled a scripted data-cleaning workflow using Python and pandas for reproducible processing of public scientific tables.

research.title: Image Classification Under Input Changes
bullets: Trained a compact image classifier using Python and PyTorch on public handwritten-symbol image collections within supervised faculty research.
Applied simple input transformations and summarized classification errors as assigned contributions to supervised research on small-image classification.
